statements.statement: The patient presents with persistent palpitations
The patient has a history of symptomatic bradycardia consistent with sick sinus syndrome
Diagnosis codes I49.5 and R00.2 were submitted
The claim was denied with reason code CO-97
A cardiac event monitoring study is indicated for diagnostic evaluation to further characterize the arrhythmia burden and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances
The denial is based on failure to demonstrate that less intensive monitoring options were attempted and deemed inadequate prior to initiating this level of diagnostic testing
